description: Kenya - Road Accidents database is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by openAFRICA (inactive). It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
